Machine Learning Engineer

Join our applied ML team building recommendation systems used by 50M
monthly users. You'll train large language models on proprietary data
and deploy them to production.

Responsibilities:
- Design and train ML models for ranking and retrieval
- Work with data scientists on experimentation
- You must have published research or shipped production ML

Required: Python, PyTorch, 3+ years ML experience.

About us: We're a 300-person company headquartered in SF. Our assistant
product helps small businesses manage operations.
